mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.merchant_id, p.product_name, p.product_image_url, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.original_price, p.sku, p.is_hot, p.is_new, p.status, p.rating, p.sales_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, m.merchant_name, -- 分类相关字段 pc.category_id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, -- 属性相关字段 av.id AS attr_value_id, a.attribute_name AS attr_name, av.value AS attr_value FROM product p LEFT JOIN merchant m ON p.merchant_id = m.merchant_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.id = pc.product_id LEFT JOIN category c ON pc.category_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_attribute_value pav ON p.id = pav.product_id LEFT JOIN attribute_value av ON pav.attribute_value_id = av.id LEFT JOIN attribute a ON av.attribute_id = a.id WHERE p.id = #{productId}

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, p.product_image_url, p.price, p.stock, p.status, p.is_hot, p.is_new, p.rating, p.sales_count FROM product p LEFT JOIN merchant m ON p.merchant_id = m.merchant_id where p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_hot = 1 ORDER BY p.sales_count DESC
